Sam notes that while both voices are audible, individual words are lost during the overlap and requests a timestamp for that portion. Hana asks for the start and end of the unintelligible span. Leo provides guidance to mark the unintelligible overlapping interval while retaining the clear parts of the clip and not discarding the whole recording.
